steps.en: Check permission; install the folder in an image-capable Codex host
steps.zh: 核对授权，在能生图的 Codex 宿主中放入技能

steps.en: Start a new conversation, upload one photograph and invoke the skill
steps.zh: 开启新对话，上传一张照片并点名技能

steps.en: Read the matching reference prompt and select spatial facts
steps.zh: 读取对应完整提示词，筛选空间事实

steps.en: Generate a photo area, abstract panel and English title as one image
steps.zh: 将摄影区域、抽象面板和英文标题生成为一张图

component.zh: 宿主图像工具，仓库不附带

value.en: One photo becomes a constrained editorial composition without writing the visual brief from scratch
value.zh: 不用从头写构图要求，把一张照片做成受约束的编辑作品
